disposition_reason: Arsenic, lead, cadmium, chromium, aluminum and mercury measured in 82 calcium supplements from the Chinese market; Table 1 prints mean, SD and range by dosage form.

study.design: Market survey of finished calcium supplements (54 tablets, 10 soft capsules, 7 granules, 10 oral liquids, 1 protein drink)
study.origin: mostly Chinese brands, several foreign brands (countries not stated)
study.method: Microwave digestion in HNO3; ICP-MS for Pb, Cd, Cr, As (Rh internal standard); ICP-AES for Al; cold-vapor AAS for Hg; flame AAS for Ca
study.qa: Calibration R2 0.998-1.000; no CRM or recovery reported
